MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels like a useful addition because its display could let me view compatible camera feeds while adding Alexa control alongside my Blink and Fire TV devices.",
    "The Blink bundle connects to my recent security-camera purchase, and its doorbell offers a new way to monitor my home, although I may not need the extra cameras."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV sticks repeat something I already have covered with a 4K stick and a Fire TV television, without giving me a clear improvement.",
    "The earbuds and tablet do not address a current need suggested by my home video and security purchases. A smart plug is relevant to home automation, but I have no particular appliance to use it with.",
    "The Echo Dots and Show 5 fit my interests, but I would choose the Show 8 because viewing camera feeds matters more to me right now than voice control alone or a smaller display."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Fire TV devices seems to have been treated as a reason to want more streaming devices, even when they duplicate what I already use.",
    "My interest in connected-home equipment seems to have been stretched into interest in many Alexa products, without a clear purpose for each one."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: an addition should extend my setup or offer a meaningful improvement over it.",
    "My recent camera purchases make practical security additions and a useful screen for camera viewing more appealing than general electronics.",
    "Compatibility and a specific use matter more to me than a shared brand; I would still need to confirm that a display supports my cameras."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my connected-home interests, but often suggested more related devices without distinguishing useful additions from equipment I already have covered."
}
